description: Incorporated in 1981, AES is a global energy company accelerating the future of energy, delivering greener, smarter energy solutions and partnering with large corporate customers on their strategic energy transitions while meeting their current energy needs. It has over four decades of experience developing, operating and owning electric generation and utilities, and is a leading provider of renewable energy to data center companies, particularly in the U.S., and to large mining companies outside the U.S. It operates two lines of business, generation and utilities, through its Renewables, Utilities, Energy Infrastructure and New Energy Technologies strategic business units, and measures their performance using Adjusted EBITDA.
